1369.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1369.1001.1.description:
Connect to ACS via API and check the list of files on flash can be accessed and verify its valid

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the ACS (container host / NFV appliance) management API is reachable and functional. Connects via the API and retrieves the flash filesystem file listing, confirming the listing call succeeds and returns the expected files/folders.

1369.1001.2.description:
Upload container image to flash via API and confirm the upload is succesful and it is shown in file listings

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies container-image upload over the API. Uploads a container application image to the device flash, then re-reads the flash file listing and confirms the uploaded image now appears, demonstrating the upload completed successfully.

1369.1001.3.description:
Delete an uploaded container image from flash and verify it is removed by checking the files on flash

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies container-image deletion over the API. Uploads an image, confirms it is present in flash, then deletes it and re-checks the flash listing to confirm the image has been removed.

1369.1001.4.description:
Create a container instance from provided image and verify the container is created on the ACS and shows up in the list of available containers

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies container-instance creation over the API. Uploads an image, creates a container instance from it, and confirms the new instance is registered on the ACS and appears in the list of compute nodes / container instances. Cleans up by stopping and deleting the instance and removing the image.

1369.1001.5.description:
Create a container instance from provided image and confirm the instance can be deleted using API

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies container-instance deletion over the API. Creates a container instance from an uploaded image, then deletes it via the API and confirms the instance no longer appears in the container-instance listing, retrying until the deletion is reflected.

1369.1001.6.description:
Create a container from .app image, start the container and verify the container instance is created and is in RUNNING state

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies starting a container instance. Creates an instance from an uploaded .app image, starts it, and polls the instance state until it reaches RUNNING, confirming the container launches successfully. Tears down by stopping and deleting the instance and image.

1369.1001.7.description:
Create a container from uploaded image, start the container and then stop it, Verify the container state is STOPPED

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the start/stop lifecycle of a container instance. Creates an instance from an uploaded image, starts it and confirms it reaches RUNNING, then stops it and confirms the state transitions to STOPPED.

1369.1001.8.description:
Create multiple containers from same image and verify each container can be individually controlled without effecting operation of other container instances

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies independent control of multiple container instances created from the same image. Creates several instances, then individually starts and stops each one, confirming each reaches the expected RUNNING/STOPPED state without affecting the operation of the other instances. Cleans up all instances and the image afterwards.

1369.1001.9.description:
Create a container instance from image and verify the container is created, Reboot ACS and confirm container instances survive across reboots

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies container persistence across an ACS reboot. Creates a container instance from an uploaded image, reboots the ACS, and after it comes back reachable confirms the previously created instance still exists, demonstrating instances survive a host reboot. Cleans up the instance and image afterwards.
